tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search long-term rental listings in Da Nang by city, district, type, bedrooms and price. Returns listing URLs; contact details are not included, send the person to the URL.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing in full, including its description.

tools.name: find_buildings
tools.description: Apartment buildings with a manager, by district.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Median rents by size and district, the middle half of asking prices with the sample behind each figure, and how many listings are on the board. Recomputed nightly.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search long-term rentals in Da Nang from a plain phrase such as '2 bedroom apartment in Son Tra under 15 million'. Returns up to 10 results with id, title and url; pass an id to fetch for the full listing. Contact details are never included, send the person to the url.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one listing by the id that search returned.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, search · Private data: search_listings, search · Public sink: search_listings, search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, search · Private data: search_listings, search · Public sink: search_listings, search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
